body.purpose: All ordinary product UI copy; Chinese text falls back to PingFang SC or Microsoft YaHei.

data.purpose: Numeric and code values that benefit from stable character widths.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for the default Card primitive.

shadows.name: interactive
shadows.purpose: Hover or selected state when a surface needs slight lift.

motion.name: state

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A compact neutral action for the single primary commit on a page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#343434; color:#fafafa; font:500 14px/1.4 Montserrat, sans-serif; transition:background 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#4a4a4a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,113,227,.25); }

components.name: Muted Input
components.description: The default low-noise field used for search and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:36px; padding:4px 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#f7f7f7; color:#252525; font:400 14px/1.4 Montserrat, sans-serif; outline:0; transition:box-shadow 180ms ease-out, background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#757575; } .ds-input:focus-visible { background:#fff; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,113,227,.2); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A short state or category label that supplements, never replaces, readable text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; min-height:20px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:9999px; background:#f7f7f7; color:#757575; font:500 12px/1.4 Montserrat, sans-serif; }

components.name: Data Panel
components.description: One framed unit for a chart, table, or decision-relevant data group.
components.html:
Recent activity

Data and controls stay in one quiet surface.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:16px; border:1px solid #ebebeb; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; color:#252525; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0; font:600 16px/1.4 Montserrat, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin:4px 0 0; color:#757575; font:400 12px/1.5 Montserrat, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Cynexus UI is a task-first application workbench. It should feel like a well-organized research desk during a busy trading session: the navigation is stable, the content is dense but legible, and every accent exists to identify a state or make the next action obvious. The canonical visual system is the neutral shadcn New York setup; the MP4 glass/gradient workspace and Application Hub tiles are local exceptions.

rules.name: The Shell-First Rule
rules.body: A new route is not complete until it uses the same workspace shell, breadcrumb, sidebar behavior, content scrolling model, and notification root as neighboring pages.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors may identify an action, selection, direction, health state, or warning. They must not be used as ambient decoration across a whole page.

rules.name: The No-Card-Wall Rule
rules.body: Do not nest cards to create hierarchy. Use a section heading, a divider, a muted row, or a single bordered container before adding another card.

dos: Do start new pages from WorkspaceShell and semantic tokens.
Do keep data, freshness, and state visible together.
Do use existing primitives and Lucide icons.
donts: Don't make the product feel like a marketing page, information site, or decorative dashboard.
Don't use large decorative gradients, heavy shadows, floating card walls, or glassmorphism on ordinary operational pages.
Don't use color alone to communicate state.
